text: Implemented the fair comparator court: frozen raw/registered six-dimension MultiMatch, fixed multiscale density, and published order-free elastic-consensus relocation; nested inner-fold ridge composites for registered MultiMatch and density; explicit availability/skips; identical outer folds, candidate sets, cross-fitted warp policy, priors, and scoring; native candidate diagnostics retained. Corrected the Wang et al. Gaussian equations and consensus normalization from the primary paper, distinguished uncalibrated compatibility bits from supervised gaze_info_bits, and added a reproducible smoke court. Evidence: 37 focused baseline assertions pass; all GazeWeave tests pass with no failures; smoke court scored 17 methods with zero outer/inner key overlap.
